example_sentences_in_bangla: আমফান ঝড়ের তাণ্ডবনৃত্য এখনো মনে ভয় ধরায়।
শহরে হঠাৎ ভাঙচুরের তাণ্ডবনৃত্য শুরু হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The rampage of the Amphan cyclone still instills fear in my mind.
A sudden spree of vandalism erupted in the city like a dance of destruction.
history: Refers to the Tandava, the vigorous cosmic dance performed by Lord Shiva in Hindu mythology during the cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction, symbolizing the end of the universe.
note: Often used metaphorically for any form of widespread devastation, drawing from Shaivite traditions prevalent in Bengali Hindu culture.
